name: tracekin
description: A local-first Codex companion with explicit, project-scoped Proof of AI Work sharing.

interface.shortDescription: Use a native Codex pet while choosing what activity data to share.
interface.longDescription: Tracekin keeps the pet experience in Codex and adds a loopback settings panel for explicit project scope, default-off sharing, redacted activity events, and visible delivery receipts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Tracekin: start its local settings panel, keep sharing off unless I explicitly choose a project and destination, and default to the currently selected Codex pet unless I ask to create a new one.
